talents.method: bench -optimize -rounds 4 at one representative race per build: 250-iteration screen of every legal one-point move, top five validated at 2,000 iterations, kept above 2.5 standard errors; applied to every race of the build (the High Order Fire variant by the same move).

consumables.method: Coordinate descent over food, Agility/Strength/Intellect elixirs, potion and weapon scrolls; 4,000 iterations, common seed, kept above a 0.2% margin; applied to every race of the build.

gear.method: search_gear.py (screen 100, validate 2000, 4 passes, 5,000 iterations) for SV Weave, Frostfire, Shockadin, Arcane, Frost and Arcane-Frost, confirmed on an independent 5,000-iteration seed (95% bound).
